verdict.rationale: Adyen's Management API supports ordering/assigning terminals to a location via API (adyen-pos-docs-11), which covers reader registration, but the evidence pack has no explicit documentation of an API endpoint to create a new location/store object, nor any example of an agent performing this end-to-end flow autonomously. Missing for 10: explicit location-creation API endpoint documentation, an end-to-end example combining location creation with reader registration, and evidence of agent/MCP-driven execution of this specific workflow.
